title: Photography Principles
slide_intent: Teach image selectors to recognize the intended photographic mood. Paired descriptors make it easier to discuss why a technically proficient picture may still be unsuitable.
strategic_value: Instacart can maintain an approachable food voice by reviewing images against warmth, familiarity and sensory character.
demonstration: A green preferred list and red contrasting list face one another. A narrow column points to the creative vision and asset library.
practical_value: Use the two lists to evaluate a candidate image, then consult the referenced project and image library for approved direction.

content_islands.name: Resource notes
content_islands.spec: Place the small project and asset-library references in a narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Comparison lists
content_islands.spec: Keep the two heading symbols and their four rows aligned. Pair warmth with its opposing tendency and use color to distinguish the preferred list.
